mapping.draft_py:
# Boneclad Necromancer (M20).
# s1: "When this creature enters, you may exile target creature card from a graveyard."
# s2: "If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token."
# The compiler hung s2's token (B5b-token-zombie) on the creature's SpellAbility, which would make
# a Zombie on cast with no exile; it belongs inside the ETB trigger behind MAY_DONE.
# Shape: "You may X. If you do, Y" = Seq(OptionalEffect(X), Conditional(MAY_DONE, Y)) (guide;
# Dire Fleet Warmonger). X: Scavenging Ooze's "Exile target card from a graveyard."
# (B3-exile-target-graveyard) with the creature-card filter of Liliana, Waker of the Dead's emblem.
zombie_token = compiled[0].effect   # the compiler's B5b-token-zombie CREATE_TOKEN, kept as is
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            OptionalEffect(
                inner=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                    'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
                    'target': Selector(
                        count=QConst(value=1),
                        mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                        filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                        zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    ),
                }),
            ),
            Conditional(pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.MAY_DONE), then_effect=zombie_token),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.CREATURE)]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may exile target creature card from a graveyard.
clauses.ir: abilities[0].event, abilities[0].effect.steps[0] (OptionalEffect MOVE_ZONE target creature card in any graveyard -> exile)

clauses.clause: If you do, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.

mapping.notes: Compiler bug fixed in the record: B5b-token-zombie dropped 'If you do' and hung the token on the creature's SpellAbility (a Zombie on cast). Record: ETB Seq(OptionalEffect(exile target creature card from a graveyard), Conditional(MAY_DONE, token)) + effect-less creature carrier.
